findings.issue: Shared component imports a page component (pages/not-found), inverting the shared/pages layering so both layers depend on each other
findings.suggestion: Move the NotFound body into shared/ (or render the not-found markup inline in LoadState) so shared has no dependency on pages

findings.issue: fetch() has no timeout or abort signal; a hung API request leaves the page's resource() stuck in loading state indefinitely
findings.suggestion: Pass an AbortSignal (e.g. AbortSignal.timeout or the resource loader's abortSignal, with shared-cache awareness) and surface a retry via resource.reload()

findings.issue: Expired cache entries are never pruned, only overwritten when the same URL is requested again, so the Map grows without bound in a long-lived session
findings.suggestion: Sweep expired entries on insertion (or keep a small LRU bound) so memory is independent of pages visited

findings.issue: cardsFor embeds view-model construction (species-name resolution, dedup, sort, extras) in the HTTP client, mixing data access with presentation concerns
findings.suggestion: Return raw refs from the client and build CardData in per-page data modules (or a dedicated cards builder) that already own view shaping

findings.issue: Scroll restoration is hand-rolled in App and duplicated in home.ts:68, where withInMemoryScrolling({scrollPositionRestoration: 'top'}) is the framework feature for this
findings.suggestion: Move the common scroll-to-top behavior into router config, keeping only the fragment-jump workaround in the Pokémon page

findings.issue: Error copy says 'Please try again' but no retry control is provided on any page
findings.suggestion: Add a retry button/button calling data.reload() on home, types and the LoadState error branch

findings.issue: Constructs fake NamedResource objects ({name, url: ''}) to reuse typeLabels, a signature-driven hack
findings.suggestion: Give typeLabels an overload taking string names (or a labelsFor(names) helper) instead of faking resource refs

findings.issue: Presentational card component injects the PokeApi service solely to compute sprite URLs in its template
findings.suggestion: Compute the sprite URL when CardData is built (e.g. in cardsFor) so the list component stays purely presentational
Handle the cast in the component (onSearch(event) reading event.target as HTMLInputElement), keeping the template type-clean

findings.issue: Species-name fallback uses the raw Pokémon name (e.g. a missing species-index entry would render an alternate-form name)
findings.suggestion: Treat a speciesIndex miss as data corruption and skip or flag the card rather than silently showing the API Pokémon name

summary: This is a high-quality, current-Angular codebase I'd merge after one round of small changes: idiomatic signals/resource/data loading, clear module boundaries, deliberate error and edge-case handling, and comments that explain why. The real asks are the shared→pages layering inversion, fetch timeouts plus cache pruning, and moving scroll handling into router config. Everything else is nit-level.
